dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you get here, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, you mean why I didn't wind up stuck in Ritou even though I'm an outlander, even back during the days of the Sakoku Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Well... Komore Teahouse only serves useful individuals. That's all I can say.
